title: FluentPath — Design & Work Plan
summary: Design and phased work plan for FluentPath, a web app to learn English with 6 worlds, 4 skills, and an AI tutor.
notes: Path is docs/plans/ (no ADR/PRD/SPEC convention). Contains scattered decision statements ('Decisiones base', dated user decision) and a stack table, but dominant shape is prose design overview + phase/status plan, not a single decision record, user stories, or API contracts. Classified DOC over ADR/SPEC; decisions noted here are context, not a formal ADR.
